title: A test still exempts the old plugins/core/bin/kit name
what: After the rename to relay@amidman (28 Oct) one test keeps an exemption for the kit command's old path plugins/core/bin/kit, because the live PATH only moves to plugins/relay/bin when relay setup --global runs after the merge. Once it has run, drop the exemption. Also the LOW leftovers of the word core the rename's check named: docs/flows.md:46, plugins/relay/README.md:3, docs/design.md:127-129.
why: Finding F3 (Gap, LOW) of the rename's review, accepted by the front as a follow-up because it can only be removed after the merge; the check of 28 Oct listed the leftover texts.
failing_case: grep for plugins/core/bin/kit in tests/ finds the exemption after relay setup --global has moved the PATH.
pass_cases: No test names plugins/core/bin/kit; the kit-name test passes with the live PATH at plugins/relay/bin.
The three docs name the relay plugin, not core.

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)
